title: GloRilla, Queen Key, and more to headline Z 107.9 Cleveland's Summer Jam concert - NewsBreak
text: As summer winds down, Cleveland is gearing up for one of its biggest hip-hop moments of the year. Z 107.9, one of the city’s leading hip-hop and R&B radio stations, has announced its highly anticipated Summer Jam concert for September 12, 2025 , at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse . This event is part of a long-standing tradition of radio station concerts that showcase a blend of national talent and regional flair — and this year’s lineup is already turning heads. Whether you’re a day-one fan of GloRilla or just looking for the next live experience to close out your summer right, Summer Jam Cleveland is set to deliver something for everyone. Related Headlines For years, Summer Jam concerts across the country have served as seasonal celebrations of music, culture, and community. Z 107.9’s version is no exception. The event is known for spotlighting both mainstream and rising artists in the rap and R&B space, offering fans a chance to witness major performances in a live, energetic setting. Cleveland has a rich hip-hop history — and concerts like this help keep that legacy alive, bringing fans together for a shared experience that’s more than just a show. This year’s Summer Jam taps into that same spirit, blending established hitmakers with breakout talent from across the country. Memphis rapper GloRilla is headlining Summer Jam Cleveland — and her presence alone is a major draw. She’s had a huge year. After dropping her “Typa” single in June and earning her first BET Award for Best Gospel/Inspirational Song for “Rain Down On Me,” GloRilla has only continued to climb. The gospel track, which features Maverick City Music , Kirk Franklin , Kierra Sheard , and Chandler Moore , showed a different side of her artistry and introduced her to new audiences. But fans of Glo’s gritty rap anthems need not worry. She’s still in her bag. Last summer, her Hot Girl Summer Tour with Megan Thee Stallion packed out arenas nationwide, and viral hits like “TGIF” and “Yeah Glo” proved her versatility and staying power in a crowded field. At just 26 years old, GloRilla is not only one of the most talked-about rappers in the game — she’s becoming one of the most consistent live performers, too. Her Cleveland appearance is likely to be one of her biggest solo stage moments of the year. The Summer Jam 2025 lineup goes beyond just one headliner. Joining GloRilla on the bill is Queen Key , the rising Chicago rapper who’s had a breakout year in 2025. In February, she dropped the fierce collaboration “Hellwoods 2” featuring GloRilla, a track that went viral on TikTok and turned heads for its aggressive flows and slick production. In April, Queen Key followed up with her “Watch This” mixtape , which solidified her as one of the Midwest’s brightest young stars. Her stage presence is electric, and her rapid-fire delivery has made her a fan favorite in both underground and mainstream circles. Also performing: Each of these artists brings their own distinct flavor, creating a genre-blending lineup that showcases hip-hop, R&B, and Southern rap in one space. While the first wave of performers is already strong, Z 107.9 has confirmed that more artists will be added to the lineup in the coming weeks. Historically, Summer Jam concerts often feature surprise guests , and with GloRilla and Big Boogie both signed to CMG (Collective Music Group) , there’s room to speculate that labelmates or collaborators could make special appearances. Z 107.9 has a track record of booking rising stars just before they blow up , so don’t be surprised if one of the upcoming announcements becomes your next favorite artist. Stay tuned to ZHipHopCleveland.com and the station’s social media pages for updates as the full roster is revealed. For fans hoping to secure a seat at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, tickets for Summer Jam 2025 officially go on sale Tuesday, July 16 at 10 a.m. ET . They’ll be available exclusively via ZHipHopCleveland.com . Given the buzz around the current lineup and the venue’s capacity, tickets are expected to move fast . If you’re planning to attend, set a reminder and be ready to grab them as soon as they drop. Z 107.9 also typically offers pre-sale opportunities, ticket giveaways , and other promotions through their mobile app and on-air programming — so it’s worth staying plugged in. While the music is the main attraction, Summer Jam is also a cultural moment . It’s a chance for Cleveland’s hip-hop fans to come together, celebrate the scene, and connect with others who share their love for the genre. The event has become a key part of the city’s music and nightlife calendar , offering a live experience that’s different from a traditional tour stop or festival. Because it’s curated by Z 107.9, fans can expect a lineup that reflects what’s hot on the airwaves , from viral TikTok tracks to underground bangers and chart-topping hits. It’s also a reminder that Midwestern cities like Cleveland play a major role in hip-hop culture — both as tastemakers and as loyal fanbases. With artists like GloRilla, Queen Key, Kash Doll, Big Boogie, and Jacquees already confirmed, Summer Jam Cleveland 2025 is shaping up to be a must-see live music event . It’s the perfect way to close out the summer — high energy, star power, and an arena full of fans who love hip-hop just as much as you do. So whether you’re there for the beats, the bars, or just to vibe out with friends, make sure September 12 is circled on your calendar. This one’s not to be missed.
